links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated cardiac imaging patient leaflets versus recommended health-literacy standards
links.effect: All three LLMs produced content above recommended patient health-literacy standards; Flesch Reading Ease: DeepSeek 70.73, Claude 60.93, ChatGPT 50.70 (p = 0.027).
links.quote: However, all three models produced content above recommended patient health-literacy standards.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient materials relative to recommended levels
links.effect: All three models produced content above recommended health-literacy standards; ChatGPT least readable (FRE 50.70), DeepSeek most readable (FRE 70.73).
links.quote: However, all three models produced content above recommended patient health-literacy standards.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the raw performance of three LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek) in generating patient education materials for cardiac imaging using readability formulas and expert assessment, without testing specific deployment safeguards or comparative organizational practices.
